snippet.title: Hermit - Official Reveal Trailer (Open World PC RPG | Fantasy Action Adventure)
snippet.description:
Wishlist now on Steam at: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3787470/Hermit?utm_source=yrt

Official Reveal Trailer for Hermit – your first look at a new upcoming open world RPG for PC gaming! Hermit is a brutal medieval fantasy role-playing game blending action RPG combat, exploration, and story-driven quests in a fully explorable open world. Get ready for next-gen gameplay, immersive character builds and progression, and dynamic world-building in the style of similar legendary open-world fantasy titles that fans of the Genre enjoy.

Set for a potential late 2026 release, Hermit will offer deep RPG mechanics, tactical combat, and branching narratives. Follow us for exclusive gameplay reveals, game updates, and development news dropping Summer and Autumn 2026.

Don't miss the next big open world PC RPG - Hermit is coming.
